config.label: Microsoft Graph access token
config.description: Microsoft Graph access token. Must be set together with MS_TODO_REFRESH_TOKEN; `mstodo-config` emits both.

config.label: Refresh token
config.description: Refresh token. Required alongside the access token, but note the env-token path does not renew: once the access token expires the server returns 401 until it is replaced.

config.label: Azure AD application (client) ID
config.description: Azure AD application (client) ID. The server reads it to refresh tokens when the stored token file carries no credentials; `mstodo-setup` also uses it.

config.label: Azure AD client secret, used for the same token refresh and by `mstodo-setup`
config.description: Azure AD client secret, used for the same token refresh and by `mstodo-setup`.

config.label: Azure AD tenant: 'organizations' (the default), 'consumers', 'common', or a tenant GUID
config.description: Azure AD tenant: 'organizations' (the default), 'consumers', 'common', or a tenant GUID.
